excerpt.zh: 这个物种曾有一个繁荣的社会，但是由于一种新型遗传病让其无法再生育。在灭族的命运面前，人们没有其他的选择，只能寄希望于数字化的救赎。
excerpt.en: Once a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

scope.zh: V3人工审阅的局部事实已迁移；整条故事尚未在V4中完整复核。
scope.en: V3 manually reviewed facts migrated; the whole story has not yet been fully re-reviewed in V4.

label.en: The population crisis and digitization plan

label.zh: 研究机器人劳工科技后
数字化完成，进入第二阶段
label.en: Digitization complete: enter the second stage

texts.zh: 这个物种曾有一个繁荣的社会，但是由于一种新型遗传病让其无法再生育。在灭族的命运面前，人们没有其他的选择，只能寄希望于数字化的救赎。
texts.en: Once a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

sections.zh:
我们对人工意识的早期探索是革命性的，由此还催生了一个纯数字化的社区，模糊俩物理世界和虚拟世界之间的边界。巨大的成功让我们沾沾自喜，我们相信自己会有无数的子孙后代可以探索创新。

但我们错了。

我们的基因编码受到了一种全新的疾病袭击，我们完全失去了繁育能力。连我们的精英都无法找到疗法，随着人口的降低和老龄化，恐慌情绪日益加剧。

绝望的驱使下，我们扩大了数字化存储，为我们人格的保存创造了足够的“空间”。但这真的是我们所希望的存在形式吗？我们的关注点现在转移到了开发足够复杂的合成躯体和正电子脑以让自己能重返现实世界。
sections.en:
Early forays into artificial consciousness were revolutionary, giving rise to a fully digital community and blurring the lines between the physical and virtual worlds. The success was so great that we grew complacent, believing we had countless generations to innovate and explore.

We were wrong.

When a novel disease attacked our genetic code, we lost the ability to procreate. A cure eluded our brightest minds, and panic grew as the population aged and dwindled.

In desperation, we expanded our digital storage, creating enough 'space' to preserve our identities. But is this truly the existence we desire? Our focus now shifts to developing synthetic bodies and a positronic brain sophisticated enough for us to remain in the physical world.

label.zh: 人口危机与数字化计划
label.en: The population crisis and digitization plan

texts.zh:
在缺乏医疗解决方案的情况下，我们有可能生还的方案便是将人口数字化存储在人格仓库中。然而，这只是一个权宜之计，后续计划已经敲定，即开发合成身体和足够复杂的正电子大脑。预计我们将有足够的时间集中精力完成这项研究。

我们最优秀的专家已经利用尖端的人工智能绘制了机器身体的蓝图，这是我们合成救赎的第一步。
texts.en:
Lacking a medical solution, our best chance for survival lies in digitizing our population within the Identity Repository. However, this is a stopgap solution, and a plan is already in place to develop synthetic bodies and a positronic brain of sufficient complexity. We estimate that we have enough time to complete the research with a focused effort.

Using cutting-edge AI, our best experts have already drawn up the blueprints for robotic bodies, the first step to our synthetic salvation.

label.zh: 研究机器人劳工科技后

texts.zh:
我们不能生育后代，但可以保存自己的思想。这个过程缓慢但必要。

随着时间的推移，我们有回到物质世界的可能，但这需要开发合成人的替代品。
texts.en:
We cannot bear offspring, but we can preserve our minds. This process is slow but necessary.

In time, it may be possible for us to return to the physical world, but doing so will require the development of synthetic replacements.

texts.zh:
我们最担心的事情发生了。

我们最后的肉体已经败给了遗传性疾病。虽然我们的数字化意识仍然安全地存储在身份存储库中，但我们缺乏将自己的思想放入人工大脑的技术。

在我们完成研究之前，我们的数字领导人只能通过机器代理与自然世界进行互动。
texts.en:
Our worst fears have come to pass.

The last of our physical bodies has expired. While our digitized consciousnesses remain safely stored in the Identity Repository, we lack the technology to place our minds in an artificial brain.

Until we have completed our research, our digital leaders will have to interact with the natural world via robotic proxies.

texts.zh:
我们已经失去了生育能力。母星上到处都是废弃的教育中心，游乐场空无一人。我们因衰老而消亡几乎只是时间问题。现在，我们只能寄希望于我们人格仓库里的数据库存了。

我们必须发展足够复杂的合成框架和正电子脑，才有可能返回物理世界。
texts.en:
We have lost the ability to procreate. Our homeworld is littered with abandoned educational centers. Playgrounds stand empty. It is only a matter of time before the last of us expires. For now, our hope lies in the digital storage of the Identity Repository.

We must develop synthetic frames and a positronic brain of sufficient complexity if we ever wish to return to the physical world.

texts.zh:
我们对机器人体的研究已经完成。我们将废弃基因诊所设施改造为机器人组装厂，并且已经升级并部署了原型机。尽管这些初级系统缺乏容纳个人意识的处理能力，但它们可以替代我们部分失去的劳动力。通过正电子链路，数字领域中的人可以将知识和经验添加到这些机器人的日常操作中，从而提高它们的性能。

同时，我们的人工智能系统已经设计出先进的智能人。我们日渐年迈的工程师们已经准备好开始工作了。
texts.en:
Our research into robotic bodies is complete. We have converted the Abandoned Gene Clinic facility into Robot Assembly Plants, and the prototypes have been upgraded and deployed. While these rudimentary systems lack the processing power to house an individual consciousness, they can replace some of our lost workforce. Through positronic uplink, those in the digital realm can add their knowledge and experience to the daily operation of these robots, improving their performance.

At the same time, our AI systems have developed a design for advanced androids. Our aging engineers stand ready to get to work.

tooltips.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]：
—机器人组装厂：+1
—£pop£机械人口：+300
tooltips.en:
[Root.Capital.GetName]:
- Robot Assembly Plants: +1 
- £pop£ Mechanical Pops: +300

texts.zh:
这项对我们机器人技术的重大升级意味着，我们现在可以殖民其他行星、我们的机器人人口也可以支持更复杂的任务了。

我们的人工智能系统认为，下一步合理的举动将是在合成身体中模拟它们的正电子矩阵。这个重大的研究项目应该允许我们将数字化的意识返回到自然世界。
texts.en:
This significant upgrade to our robotic technology means it is now possible to colonize other planets and for our mechanized population to support more complex tasks.

Our AI systems believe the next logical step would be to mimic their positronic matrixes in synthetic bodies. This significant research project should allow us to return a digitized consciousness to the natural world.

label.en: We must not give up now.

texts.zh:
通过不懈的努力，我们终于取得了成功。我们设计出了功能齐全的正电子大脑，其复杂程度足以容纳我们的人格。

虽然我们无法战胜死亡，但我们很快就不再受生物存在的限制约束。
texts.en:
After relentless work, we have finally achieved success. A fully functional positronic brain has been designed, one sophisticated enough to contain our identities.

While we cannot overcome mortality, we will soon no longer be bound by the limitations of a biological existence.

label.zh: 是时候让我们合成觉醒了。
label.en: Its time for our Synthetic awakening.

tooltips.zh: 这些事件必须采纳合成传统才能进展。
tooltips.en: To progress with these events we must embrace the Synthetic Tradition.

texts.zh:
我们的组装工厂和合成化专家已经摩拳擦掌要开始这项将人格转移到正电子脑和合成躯体的里程碑式的任务了。

我们将开始将重点放在那些仍然生活在物质世界的人们身上，旨在一劳永逸地根除这种遗传疾病。随着合成大脑处理能力的提升，我们甚至能够挣脱肉体的束缚。

我们可以专注于增强决策制定流程，增加记忆容量，或优化脑躯协调，这些选择都会增强特定的岗位。或者我们也可以进行雨露均沾的耐用性强化。

这些功能需要持续的投入，并且只会在建有机器人组装建筑的行星上生效，但我们从这些测试组中所获得的数据会对生产力有立即的提升效果。
texts.en:
Our assembly plants and synthesization experts stand ready to begin the monumental task of transferring identities into positronic brains and synthetic bodies.

We will initiate our efforts by focusing on those still residing in the physical world, aiming to eradicate the genetic disease once and for all. With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can even surpass our biological constraints.

We could focus on amplifying the decision making process, increase memory storage, or streamline mind-limb coordination, all of which would improve certain types of jobs. Alternatively, we could improve the durability of all bodies.

These functions require continuous support and will only be available on planets with a robot assembly building, but our learnings from the design will give immediate productivity benefits.

texts.zh:
我们的组装工厂和合成化专家已经摩拳擦掌要开始这项将人格转移到正电子脑和合成躯体的里程碑式的任务了。

由于在星球上失去了物理存在，我们必须快速建造我们第一具原型躯体。随着合成大脑处理能力的提升，我们甚至能够挣脱肉体的束缚。

我们可以专注于增强决策制定流程，增加记忆容量，或优化脑躯协调，这些选择都会增强特定的岗位。或者我们也可以进行雨露均沾的耐用性强化。

这些功能需要持续的投入，并且只会在建有机器人组装建筑的行星上生效，但我们从这些测试组中所获得的数据会对生产力有立即的提升效果。
texts.en:
Our assembly plants and synthesization experts stand ready to begin the monumental task of transferring identities into positronic brains and synthetic bodies.

Without a physical presence in the world, we must rapidly construct our first prototype body. With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can even surpass our biological constraints.

We could focus on amplifying the decision making process, increase memory storage, or streamline mind-limb coordination, all of which would improve certain types of jobs. Alternatively, we could improve the durability of all bodies.

These functions require continuous support and will only be available on planets with a robot assembly building, but our learnings from the design will give immediate productivity benefits.

label.zh: 数字化完成，进入第二阶段
label.en: Digitization complete: enter the second stage

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]已经有几十年都没有拥抱过新生儿了。尽管我们可能再也无法体会那种感觉，但今天我们的人民迎来了希望的回归。

我们研发出了人格复合体，这是一种先进的研究中心，我们可以复制现有的人格，从而实质上创造新造的人。

我们可以从多个个体中随机选择个性点，通过无数组合创造新的人格身份。或者，我们还可以效仿自然的过程，在一个开放的虚拟环境中培养“心灵内核”。
texts.en:
It has been decades since a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] held a newborn child in their arms. While we may never know that feeling again, today marks the return of hope for our people.

We've developed Identity Complexes, advanced centers where we can copy existing identities to essentially create new people.

We could randomize personality points from multiple individuals, creating new identities through countless combinations. Alternatively, we might mimic nature's process by nurturing 'mind kernels' in an open virtual setting.

label.zh: 我们把人格混合起来吧。

texts.zh:
今天标志着我们的数字化旅程的终点。没有人能否认已经完成的伟大事业，及其实现所必需的牺牲。

我们现在以一个全面数字化和合成人民族出现。我们不再会屈从于疾病的恐怖。我们也不再会被脆弱的遗传限制。

我们现在可以自由地创造任何我们认为合适的现实。
texts.en:
Today marks the end of our digital journey. No one can deny the magnitude of what has been done, nor the sacrifice necessary to achieve it.

We now stand ascended as a fully digitized and synthetic people. No longer shall we yield to the horrors of disease. No more shall the limitations of feeble genetics confine us.

We are free to create any reality we see fit.

tooltips.zh: [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName]获得['concept_synthetic_dawn']特质
tooltips.en: [This.Owner.GetSpeciesName] gains the ['concept_synthetic_dawn'] trait

texts.zh:
得益于政府的努力，所有有意愿的公民都已经将意识转化为了数字形式。合成化打开了一条我们从未设想的道路，带来了全新的挑战与机遇。

通过将我们的努力推向现实世界，我们可以选择将数字化意识跨越无尽的空间传输到提前准备好的新躯体，或是设计出远程替身士兵来降低战争的残酷性。
texts.en:
Thanks to the efforts of our government, the consciousness of every willing citizen has been transferred into digital form. Synthesization has opened paths we cannot yet imagine, leading to new challenges and possibilities.

By focusing our efforts on the physical world, we could transport our digitized minds across great distances to a new body already prepared for us. Or we can come up with means to create remotely operated surrogate soldiers to alleviate the rigors of war.

label.zh: 我们应该关注迁徙的自由。
label.en: We should focus on freedom of movement.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于强制迁移和区划。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on resettlement and districts.

label.zh: 我们必须为战争的恐怖做准备。
label.en: We must prepare for the horrors of war.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于厌战度和亚光速旅行。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on war exhaustion and sublight travel.

texts.zh:
将所有人口进行合成化是一项巨大的工程。这必然会引起反响。在适应新常态的过程中，无数的挑战和独特的机遇无疑将影响我们日常的生活。

面对这些变化的态度将决定我们未来的社会。
texts.en:
Synthesization of an entire population is an undertaking of monumental proportions. There are bound to be repercussions. As we adapt to the new normal, untold challenges and unique opportunities will undoubtedly affect our daily lives.

How we confront these changes will define our society for ages to come.

texts.zh:
合成化以我们前所未见的方式影响着社会，而普遍的看法是我们甚至还能更进一步。目前的合成躯体还可以改进，甚至完全抛弃它成为虚拟的存在。

如果我们决定为每个人分配一个合成躯体，那么官员就能临时接管政府众筹无效成员的身体。或者，我们也可以彻底抛弃物理存在，寻求完全虚拟的公共体验，着将使我们比以往任何时候都更有效地执行决策。
texts.en:
While the synthesization has already affected society in ways we could have never anticipated, the general sentiment is that we could go even further. Our current synthetic bodies can be improved, or even discarded entirely for fully virtual existence.

If we decide to assign a synthetic body to everyone, it could enable officials to temporarily take over the bodies of ineffective members of the government. Alternatively, foregoing bespoke physical forms in favor of a fully virtual, communal experience would enable us to execute decisions with more efficiency than ever before.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于官僚效率。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on bureaucratic efficiency.

label.zh: 研究全息虚拟监管选项。

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于法令和帝国规模。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on edicts and empire size.

texts.zh:
对人口的完全合成化迎来了卓著的成功。我们的有机过往被扫入历史的垃圾桶，但为了踏出前进的道路，[From.GetRulerName][From.GetRulerTitle]要求我们的杰出人才无条件的服从，并做出抉择。

提升我们的合成躯体可以让单个意识控制多个躯体。或者我们还可以完全抛弃现实空间，通过虚拟的环境完全操控公众的情绪。
texts.en:
Complete synthesization of the population has proved a resounding success. Our organic past been left in the dust of history, but to charter a way forward, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] requires both the unconditional obedience of our brightest minds, and a decision.

Improving our synthetic bodies would allow individuals to control multiple hosts as one. Alternatively, we could forgo physical space entirely, manipulating public sentiment through a fully virtual environment.

label.zh: 专注于对复数躯体的神经同步。

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于劳工和区划。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on workers and districts.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于建筑和政府法令。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on buildings and government ethics.

texts.zh:
合成化以我们前所未见的方式影响着社会，但公众还想更进一步。合成躯体可以成为我们人格的延伸，或仅仅作为我们虚拟意识遥控着的工具。我们走到了一个岔道口上。

我们可以研究将意识在可抛弃的躯体耗材之间快速转移，或者可以选择专注于从已逝之人中提取知识来加速我们的研究工作。
texts.en:
While the synthesization has already affected the empire in unforeseen ways, the population seems willing to go even further. Our synthetic bodies could become extensions of our identity, or mere tools to control remotely by our virtual consciousness. Our path is yet undecided.

We can research means to rapidly transfer a consciousness from one expendable body to another. Alternatively, we could focus on extracting knowledge from the recently deceased to accelerate our research efforts.

label.zh: 关注从已逝的意识中提取知识。
label.en: Look into extracting knowledge from the deceased.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于领袖和科研。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on leaders and research.

label.zh: 研究快速意识转移技术。

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于陆军和舰船。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on armies and ships.

texts.zh:
我们对整个社会的合成化工作值得进行深入的风险收益分析。虽然我们即将进入一个全新的光明合成未来，但这也抛下了更注重物质的客户群。在理想情况下，我们希望这两个部分都能在一定程度上有所保留。

人工智能等合成化相关领域的进步将使我们能够给无生命的物体注入基本的生命，并推出多条产品线。而对虚拟空间进行更全面的探索，则可以使人们的记忆成为一种新型商品。
texts.en:
Synthesization of our entire society merits an in-depth risk and benefit analysis. While we are entering a new, profitable frontier of synthesized future, we are also leaving our more materialistically aligned customer base behind. In a perfect world we would like to retain both segments in some capacity.

Advancements in synthesization-related fields such as artificial intelligence would allow us to imbue inanimate objects with rudimentary life, and launch multiple product lines. A more complete exploration of the virtual space would make it possible to tap into people's memories as a new type of commodity.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于生产和利润。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on production and profit.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的合成社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Synthetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于贸易、商品和情报。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on trade, goods, and intel.

texts.zh:
我们成功将所有人格身份迁移到新的合成框架或人格仓库中，确保了人民的存续。

然而，我们遇到了一个新的挑战。我们创造的用于存储数字身份的数字“空间”本应是权宜之计，但居民们已经习惯于这种生存状态，不愿意返回物理世界。

我们可以允许他们继续留在数字世界中，但强制他们进入新的合成身体也是一种可行的选项。
texts.en:
We have successfully relocated every identity into either a new synthetic frame or the Identity Repository, ensuring the continuation of our people.

However, a new challenge has emerged. The digital 'space' we created to store our digital identities was always meant to be temporary, but the inhabitants have grown accustomed to this existence and are reluctant to return to the physical world.

We could allow them to remain there, but the option to compel them into new synthetic bodies is also an alternative.

label.zh: 就让他们在乐园中享福吧。

tooltips.zh: 剩下的数字人格身份将会留在人格仓库，继续从内部提供支持。
tooltips.en: The remaining digital identities will stay in the Identity Repository and continue to support our people from within.

label.zh: 团结在一起我们才能更强大。
label.en: We are stronger if we stay together.

tooltips.zh: 我们将余下的数字人格身份植入当前库存的合成人体内，同时为其余人建造新的机架。人格仓库将被销毁。
tooltips.en: We will place the remaining digital identities into our current stock of synthetic bodies and build new frames for the rest. The Identity Repository will be destroyed.
